records.title: AutoViewMem: Self-Configuring Orthogonal Views for Conversational Long-Term Memory
records.reason: AutoViewMem self-configures orthogonal memory views to reduce semantic interference in top-K retrieval for conversational long-term memory; an agent memory representation method, adjacent to inference-time retrieval but not a serving contribution, hence borderline.

records.title: AMU:Admission and Memory Update for Personalized Conversations - Structured Memory with SLM Guided Control
records.reason: AMU controls memory admission and updates for personalized conversations using structured memory with a small-model guided controller; a memory write-path governance method for assistants, not an inference system mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Understanding the Power Consumption of Modern High Bandwidth Memory: Experimental Analysis and Modeling Using Real HBM2 DRAM Chips
records.reason: Real HBM2 chips are experimentally characterized to build accurate power models and expose data-pattern-dependent consumption; memory-hardware measurement relevant to inference infrastructure, but a characterization study without an inference mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to EEG analysis and decoding via an autonomous research framework, a brain-signal application, with no LLM inference subject stated in the title.

records.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
records.reason: EvoMemState maintains evolving memory state for personal LLM agents so new facts update and constrain earlier ones instead of sitting as independent facts; an agent memory consistency method without serving or decoding content, so borderline.

records.title: Attention Is Not All You Need Anymore
records.reason: A family of drop-in self-attention replacements aims to preserve transformer performance while changing the attention computation; an architecture proposal whose abstract centers on performance retention rather than demonstrated LLM inference gains, so borderline.

records.title: Translational Equivariance in Kernelizable Attention
records.reason: Kernelizable attention is given translational equivariance so relative-position inductive biases survive without materializing the full attention matrix; efficient-attention theory with an inference-relevant motivation but no LLM inference evaluation, hence borderline.

records.title: Portus: Efficient DNN Checkpointing to Persistent Memory with Zero-Copy
records.reason: Portus checkpoints DNN models from GPUs to persistent memory over RDMA with a zero-copy three-level index; training checkpoint infrastructure, not inference serving or execution.

records.title: On Pretraining for Project-Level Code Completion
records.reason: Repository-level pretraining strategies and a 16K context extension are studied for project-level code completion with OpenCoder; a pretraining study for a coding capability, not inference.

records.title: EvoMem: Improving Multi-Agent Planning with Dual-Evolving Memory
records.reason: EvoMem gives LLM multi-agent planning frameworks dual-evolving memory inspired by working memory; an agent planning memory method whose contribution is coordination quality, not inference systems, so borderline.

records.title: QwT-v2: Practical, Effective and Efficient Post-Training Quantization
records.reason: QwT-v2 improves post-training quantization with lightweight compensating structures while removing the extra latency and incompatibility of the original QwT; a practical quantization contribution directly reducing model inference resource use, hence accept.

records.title: LongT5-Mulla: LongT5 With Multi-Level Local Attention for a Longer Sequence
records.reason: LongT5-Mulla adds multi-level local attention so LongT5 handles longer sequences than full quadratic attention allows; an efficient-attention architecture variant for long-text tasks, but an older model-line study without LLM serving evidence, so borderline.

records.title: The Curious Case of Factuality Finetuning: Models' Internal Beliefs Can Improve Factuality
records.reason: Factuality finetuning is studied through models' internal beliefs to reduce hallucination with the right training data; a training-data study for output factuality with no inference contribution.

records.title: Synthetic bootstrapped pretraining
records.reason: Synthetic bootstrapped pretraining learns inter-document relations to synthesize a new corpus for joint LM pretraining; a pretraining data method with no inference mechanism.

records.title: Affinitention nets: kernel perspective on attention architectures for set classification with applications to medical text and images
records.reason: Affinitention nets give a kernel view of attention for set classification, applied to pathology slides and medical text; a medical/vision set-classification method with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Small Character Models Match Large Word Models for Autocomplete Under Memory Constraints
records.reason: Small character-level models match large word models for open-domain autocomplete under explicit memory constraints; model sizing under memory limits is inference-adjacent, but the study is a task comparison rather than an inference mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: Attention is All You Need Until You Need Retention
records.reason: A retention layer gives transformers persistent memory read by attention and written during use, reframed as social learning over other agents' behavior; a speculative architecture/memory proposal without an inference-system evaluation, hence borderline.

records.title: GPT-C: Generative PrompT Compression
records.reason: GPT-C generatively compresses long prompts to accelerate LLM inference and relieve context-window limits while preserving task performance; a direct prompt-compression contribution to inference cost, hence accept.

records.title: Accelerating Parallel Structures in DNNs via Parallel Fusion and Operator Co-Optimization
records.reason: Magneto is an ML compiler that broadens parallel fusion scope and co-optimizes operators to accelerate DNN inference; compiler-level inference optimization, but demonstrated for generic DNN structures rather than LLM serving, so borderline.

records.title: The curious case of developmental BERTology: On sparsity, transfer learning, generalization and the brain
records.reason: This essay connects developmental neuroscience with sparsity, transfer learning and generalization in BERT-era models; a perspective piece with no inference-system contribution.
